SECRET

A. Canning Esq., M.V.O., O.B.E.,
Chief Constable,
Special Branch,
New Scotland Yard.

Thank you for your letter No. 320/EPA/517 dated 5th October, 1939. The necessary action has been taken re Arthur William OLDAG.

9 October, 1939. (cd) E. H. Harman.
